title: Multi-Source Grid BFS
statement:
For each queried passable cell find its shortest orthogonal distance to any source.

Input
n m q, then n rows with # for walls, . for empty cells, and S for sources. Then read q passable 1-based row/column pairs.

Output
Print each distance, or −1 if no source is reachable.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,m ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000.
